findings.current: *It spent too much power before it could recover from the effects of Teleport. It needs a little time.*
findings.defect: The draft makes the Doppelganger the one who needs time to recover. Jin is assessing his own depleted strength; the next paragraph says the Skeleton King is in the same position.
findings.rationale: The following ‘이건 스켈레톤 킹도 마찬가지다’ compares the Skeleton King’s condition with Jin’s, not the Doppelganger’s.
findings.replacement: *I used too much power before I could recover from the effects of the Teleport spell. I need a little time.*
findings.source: ‘텔레포트 마법의 여파를 수습하기도 전에 너무 큰 힘을 소모했다. 약간의 시간이 필요해.’

findings.current: But it still pissed me off to hear the bastard, wearing nothing but a shell, mock him.
findings.defect: “Mock him” specifies Bassman as the target of the taunt, which the source does not.
findings.rationale: The source describes Jin’s disgust at the impostor’s mockery without assigning Bassman as its target.
findings.replacement: But it still pissed me off to listen to the taunts of a bastard wearing someone else’s shell.
findings.source: 하지만 한낱 껍데기를 뒤집어쓴 놈의 조롱을 듣고 있자니 기분이 더러운 것도 사실이다.

findings.current: A barren wasteland where not a single tree or weed grew, now a ruin no one ever visited.
findings.defect: “No one ever visited” changes the source’s present abandonment into an absolute claim about the ruin’s history.
findings.rationale: 이제는 marks the ruin as unvisited now.
findings.replacement: A barren wasteland where not a single tree or weed grew, now a ruin no one visited anymore.
findings.source: 나무 한 그루, 잡초 하나 자라나지 않는 황무지였고, 이제는 그 누구도 찾지 않는 폐허였다.

findings.current: “A monster like you is the exception.”
findings.defect: The line drops the insult in 몬스터 새끼, softening Jin’s deliberate hostility.
findings.rationale: Jin explicitly pairs ‘monster’ with a personal insult as he rejects the Doppelganger’s claim to Bassman’s standing.
findings.replacement: “A monster like you doesn’t count, you bastard.”
findings.source: 너 같은 몬스터 새끼는 예외로 쳐야지.

summary: One critical subject reversal, one unsupported target of mockery, and two smaller fidelity issues.
